messages:
elena (CS): Hey team — i'm assembling a very short, customer-facing 'quick-fix' runbook for accounts that show velocity drops or latency spikes before renewal. Want it to be scannable: 1-page checklist + 15-min walkthrough + a tiny diag curl. Quick review please.

mohit (ENG): Nice. Keep it non-technical for PMs but include a single safe cmd for CS to run. Recommend runtime hints: cache TTL 20-30s, batch max 10 for interactive widgets, stream=true.

mohit (ENG): Pasteable diag curl (safe read-only):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"<sample prompt>","stream":false}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '.latencies, .cache_hit'
```

tara (CS Ops): Add prefill playbook steps: 1) Prefill: push top-5 prompts once at 10 qps for 30s. 2) Warm-run: 120 synthetic requests at 2 qps for 3m. 3) Smoke: capture lat_p50/95, cache_hit_rate, avg_tokens. Attach 3 traces.

samira (DE): UX: top of page should have a 1-line decision map: "cache_hit_rate < 20% -> prefill; tokens_per_req > 350 -> trim prompts or request quantized variant; p95 > 1s -> reduce batch size or enable streaming." Also add a tiny rollback note.

elena (CS): Draft 15-min script: 0:00-1:00 goal + expectations; 1:00-5:00 show cold vs warmed run; 5:00-9:00 walk runtime snippet + prefill steps; 9:00-12:30 review telemetry snapshot + identify top risk; 12:30-15:00 agree mitigations + assign eng owner.

mohit (ENG): runtime snippet to include:```
# field hint (small/mid tenants)
cache_enabled: true
cache_ttl_ms: 25000
batching:
  max_batch_size: 10
  timeout_ms: 8
streaming: true
```

tara (CS Ops): Troubleshooting matrix for one-pager (short): "p95 > 1000ms -> lower max_batch_size or enable streaming; cache_hit_rate < 15% -> check prompt variability and enable client prefill; sustained errors -> gather 3 sample ids + escalate to eng-oncall."

ops-bot: reminder: attach last-8 warm-run traces to tenant ticket and set reminder 24h before call.

elena (CS): i'll convert to a printable checklist with checkboxes: Prefill done, Warm-run done, Traces attached, Telemetry snapshot, Mitigation chosen, Eng owner assigned. Will post PDF to ticket and ping #cs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
